cleanup_scopes: Only exact ignored experiment/cache leaves and original snapshot paths; no tracked source edits by cleanup.
source_edit_policy: Parallel source work preserved; no final clean-worktree claim.
accounting_limit: du charges shared COW extents per path and is not exclusive physical storage. Whole-volume available deltas include unrelated concurrent writes. Exact unlink net and serial COW observation are reported separately; do not add du savings to either.
